name: Amazon FTW1 Fulfillment Center, Dallas TX

fieldNotes.truckGate: Fully fenced perimeter (black palisade fence) around the entire trailer yard, confirmed in Street View (06-sv-nwentry, 06-sv-gate-s, 06-sv-gate-sw). The main truck entrance is a controlled driveway off the north public road at the NW corner, channelized with orange traffic barrels/cones funneling trucks through a checkpoint (06-sv-mainentry, 06-sv-mainentry2).
fieldNotes.guardShack: Small tan guard booth sits beside the entry lane at the NW gate, visible in Street View (06-sv-mainentry2) and in satellite at the SW pinch of the entry (06-wcorner-z20, 06-boothtight-z21) as a small 1-2-space-footprint structure with channelizing barrels and a staged tractor-trailer.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Wide paved apron outside the gate where the public road meets the entry driveway, with room for trucks to wait before the checkpoint (06-nwcorner-entry-z20, 06-sv-mainentry).
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Very large interior paved yard between the gate and the dock doors / drop rows - ample post-gate holding (06-northdocks-z19).
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep gate-to-dock approach across a wide apron can hold a queue of 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Two separate curb cuts / driveways off the north road - distinct in-gate (NW) and a second driveway/exit further east (06-northdocks-z19, 06-nwcorner-entry-z20).
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Estimated ~2 inbound lanes at the wide gate apron; exact count not directly resolvable overhead due to barrel placement. Listed uncertain.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide gate apron with substantial unused paved width - clear room to add an express/appointment bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Loading docks on the north, west and SE building faces with regular dock-door rhythm and 100+ trailers backed in across faces (06-northdocks-z19, 06-westdocks-z19, 06-southdocks-z19). dockDoorCount ~130 is an honest overhead estimate; band 50+ is firm.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Dedicated trailer drop rows north of the dock walls and along the west yard, dozens of trailers parked without tractors; capacity 50+ is firm.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Distinct dock banks on physically separate building faces (north wall vs west wall vs SE wall) - shipping and receiving run from different clusters.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Within the Dallas metro directly on LBJ Freeway (I-635 / US-175) interchange; Urban.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Major metro freight corridor, strong cellular coverage; false.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Only the single large Amazon fulfillment building is on this parcel. The neighboring building to the SE is American Textile Co (confirmed by Street View signage, 06-sv-boulevard2) on a separate parcel/loop and is excluded.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale / weigh pad visible in the truck path.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage drop rows separate from active dock staging, full of parked trailers (06-northdocks-z19, 06-westdocks-z19).
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~36.8 acres derived from the traced Amazon parcel perimeter (building + fenced yard + drop rows + south employee parking).
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
